verdict.rationale: Firecrawl's docs describe exhaustive crawling (crawl entire site, discover all URLs) and an agent with adjustable 'reasoning effort' (firecrawl-gh-2, firecrawl-gh-3, firecrawl-gh-4), but there is no evidence of adaptive crawling that automatically halts once sufficient information to answer a query has been gathered — crawls appear to run to completion or a set limit rather than dynamically stopping on relevance/sufficiency.
